title: Major Headlines Double-Take Crème & Powder Blush Duo & Lip Balm Makeup Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A limited-edition gift set featuring seasonal shades of the bestselling cream and powder blush duo and smoothing lip balm.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Peptides (Lip Balm): Stimulates collagen production for visibly plumped, contoured, and volumized lips.
- Bakuchiol (Lip Balm): Smooths and softens lips.

What Else You Need to Know: Treat yourself and your friends to something sweet and spicy this season. This gourmand gift set includes a matching blush and lip balm in brand-new shades that are only here for the holidays: Vanilla Chai and Gingerbread Latte. The blush includes a dewy cream and matte powder designed for you to wear separately or together to customize your look. The high-shine lip balm has a cushiony texture an
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Major Headlines Double-Take Crème & Powder Blush Duo:
Just cream:
-For a dewy look, dab and blend just cream onto cheeks with the dense end of a blush brush.
Just powder:
-For a matte, airbrushed look, apply just powder onto cheeks with the fluffy end of a blush brush.

Cream over powder:
-For long-lasting glam and Patrick's signature technique, layer cream over powder.
-For best results, pair with PATRICK TA Dual-Ended Blush Brush (sold separately).

Major Moisture Smoothing Lip Balm:
-Generously apply to lips for an irresistible wash of shine, moisture, and flavor.
-Apply before glam for a moisturizing prep step, then reapply at the end for the perfect finishing touch.

Artistry tip:
-For a more full-coverage lip, layer over any shade of PATRICK TA’s Precision Lip Crayon or Major Headlines Matte Suede Lipstick (each sold separately).
Ingredients+
-Peptides (Lip Balm): Stimulates collagen production for visibly plumped, contoured, and volumized lips.
-Bakuchiol (Lip Balm): Smooths and softens lips.

Major Headlines Double-Take Crème & Powder Blush Duo - Something Sweet
Cream:
Ppg-3 Benzyl Ether Myristate, Phenyl Trimethicone, Dipentaerythrityl Hexahydroxystearate/Hexastearate/Hexarosinate, Ethylhexyl Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Triisostearyl Citrate, Polyethylene, Nylon-12, Polyisobutene, Octyldodecanol, Vinyl Dimethicone/Methicone Silsesquioxane Crosspolymer, Silica, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Propylene Carbonate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Water, Tocopheryl Acetate, Alumina, May Contain (+/-): Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 30 Lake (Ci 73360), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

Powder/Poudre:
Mica, Magnesium Myristate, Nylon-12, Silica, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Glyceryl Triacetyl Ricinoleate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Peg-12 Dimethicone, Trimyristin, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Peg-12 Allyl Ether, Caprylyl Glycol, Hydrogenated Phosphatidylcholine, Phenoxyethanol, Water, Alumina, Hexylene Glycol, Tocopheryl Acetate, May Contain (+/-): Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Tin Oxide, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Ultramarines (Ci 77007).


Major Moisture Smoothing Lip Balm - Vanilla Chai
Lip Balm/Lip Balm/Baume à Lèvres:
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Diisostearyl Malate, Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Fragrance, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopherol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Tribehenin, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Dipalmitoyl Hydroxyproline, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Stevia Rebaudiana Extract, Benzyl Benzoate, Sorbitan Isostearate, Cinnamal, Bakuchiol, Lactic Acid, Eugenol, Benzyl Alcohol, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Red 7 (CI 15850), Iron Oxides (CI 77499).
